answer: A hollow identity has no anchor in the real world, so bind each agent to one distinct amateur-radio callsign issued by the national regulator after a licence exam. Callsigns are public, scarce and one per person, listed in an open callbook anyone can check. A farm spinning up a thousand fakes would need a thousand licensed operators, and like a ripple from a single stone, one exposed callsign traces the whole cluster. A zephyr of fake accounts cannot pass an exam-gated registry.
